title: typocasual site data
description: Contract for static/data.json. This file is the single source of truth for the front page: the six typeface frames and the outbound link cards. scripts/check.mjs validates data.json against it and runs before every deploy.

$schema.description: Points editors and agents at this schema for validation and autocomplete.

frames.description: One frame per typeface. The frame count is the face count.

linksHead.description: Heading above the outbound link cards.

links.description: Outbound links, rendered as preview cards.

frame.description: One typeface. The specimen is set live in the browser, so the reader sees the real face, not an image of it.

role.description: The job this face does. Must be unique across frames.

name.description: The family name. Must match the first family in `stack`, and must be loaded by the fonts link in layouts/partials/head.html.

specimen.description: The sample line, set in the face.

stack.description: A CSS font-family value, e.g. "\"Lora\", Georgia, serif".

why.description: Why this face, in one sentence.

used.description: Where it appears on the site.

link.description: One outbound link card. The domain label and the favicon are derived from `url`.
